headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 29, 2026**
article:
The Cleveland Guardians secured a thrilling 6-5 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Kyle Manzardo leading the charge at the plate. Manzardo's impressive performance included a home run and 4 RBIs. In a contrasting result, the Reds took down the Guardians 2-0, with Jose Franco earning the win. JJ Bleday led the Reds' offense with a home run, his 18th of the season.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Casey Schmitt has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left knee meniscus tear. The Minnesota Twins have also been affected, with Cole Sands and Mike Paredes joining the injured list due to a right elbow strain and left oblique strain, respectively. Kerry Carpenter and Spencer Steer have also been placed on the injured list due to left foot plantar fasciitis and a right wrist sprain, respectively.

The trade market has been active, with several notable moves. The Pittsburgh Pirates acquired RF Johnathan Rodríguez from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for cash. The Chicago White Sox traded RHP José Urquidy to the Pirates for RHP Felix Doroteo.

top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jose Franco earning the win. In the game, JJ Bleday led the Reds' offense with a home run, his 18th of the season.

top_news.title: **Tigers Rout Orioles 14-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dominated the Baltimore Orioles, securing a 14-0 victory behind a strong team effort. Eduardo Valencia led the Orioles' offense with 4 hits, including 2 home runs, while Troy Melton pitched 7 shutout innings for the Tigers.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Edge Pirates in Thrilling 8-7 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks secured a hard-fought 8-7 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Brandon Lowe leading the offense. Lowe hit 2 home runs and drove in 2 runs in the game.

top_news.title: **Giants Place Casey Schmitt on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants left fielder Casey Schmitt has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left knee meniscus tear. The injury occurred on July 28, 2026.

top_news.title: **Rodríguez Traded to Pittsburgh**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates acquired RF Johnathan Rodríguez from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for cash on July 27, 2026.
